description: This file defines the UnauthorizedException class within the OrangeHRM authentication plugin. It extends the base Exception class to include a Response object, indicating that this exception type is used for handling unauthorized access scenarios with associated HTTP response details.

classes.name: UnauthorizedException
classes.description: Custom exception class for unauthorized access, encapsulating an HTTP Response object.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the UnauthorizedException with a Response object, message, code, and optional previous Throwable.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the associated HTTP Response object.

methods.name: setResponse
methods.description: Sets the associated HTTP Response object.
